content: Discord webhooks (discord.com/developers/docs/resources/webhook, fetched 2026-08): POST to /webhooks/{id}/{token} with content, embeds, username, avatar_url, tts, allowed_mentions, flags, thread_name, poll. wait=true returns message object; Get/Edit/Delete Webhook Message endpoints allow updating/deleting sent messages by token. Discord-flavour markdown. Components/buttons: application-owned webhooks can always send; NON-application-owned webhooks cannot send interactive components (components field ignored unless with_components query param) because interactions must route to an owning application. Also exposes Slack-compatible and GitHub-compatible execute endpoints translating foreign payloads. Effectively one-way for plain incoming webhooks.
